en.t: There was no other letter besides this.

units.source_text: 梅壶女御收到了这些画，觉得不写回信太无礼貌。

en.t: When the Lady of the Plum Pavilion received these paintings, she felt it would be too discourteous not to send a reply.

units.source_text: 她沉思多时，便将当年所用的那把栉子折断一端，

en.t: After pondering for a long while, she broke off one end of the comb she had used in those days,
and on that end she wrote a poem:
